data.name: Bob
data.message: Finishing asteroids, then heading toward medbay.

I reported Bob’s body in Weapons. My route was Navigation → Security → Weapons. I saw Charlie enter Security from the Weapons direction around tick 6, then I went up to Weapons and found Bob dead there. That makes Charlie worth questioning, but I want to hear their route and timing before hard accusing.

I don’t have much info on the body. My route was Storage → Medbay, and I didn’t run into anyone at all this round. I never went near Weapons or Security, and I didn’t see Bob.

Eve’s report puts the body in Weapons and says Charlie came from that direction into Security around tick 6, so I agree Charlie needs to give a clear route and timing. For now I’m not hard accusing, just noting I can’t vouch for anyone.

I don’t have direct info on Bob. I spawned/started in lower engine and went to Storage to do my task there. I didn’t see anyone at all, no one came through Storage while I was there, and I never went near Security or Weapons.

Based on Eve’s report, Charlie is the main person who needs to explain their route clearly, especially if they were coming out of the Weapons side into Security around tick 6. I can’t vouch for anyone right now, but I’m listening for Charlie’s timing and whether Frank saw anything.

I don’t have anything direct on the body either. I started in Upper Engine, went up to Oxygen for my task, then came back to Upper Engine. I didn’t see anyone at all, and I never went near Weapons, Security, or Bob.

So from my side I can’t clear anyone. Eve’s info is the only concrete thing so far: Bob in Weapons, and Charlie seen coming into Security from the Weapons side around tick 6. Charlie definitely needs to explain route and timing clearly. If that lines up badly, Charlie is probably our best vote; otherwise I’d be cautious.

"Eve's observation is completely accurate, I'm not going to deny it. My route was Cafeteria -> Weapons -> Security. I was heading to Security for my cameras task. 

When I passed through Weapons, I did see Bob, but he was perfectly fine and alive. I walked past him and went down into Security, which is exactly when Eve saw me. If Bob is dead, he had to have been killed in that tiny window right after I left. That leaves two possibilities: either someone came into Weapons from the Cafeteria side right behind me, OR Eve killed him when she walked in and is using our passing in Security as a convenient way to frame me. 

I'm telling the truth about leaving him alive, and the fact that I'm confirming Eve's timeline should show I'm not hiding my route. I'm going to skip because I can't be 100% sure if Eve self-reported or if a ninja came from Cafeteria, but please don't just blindly vote me on circumstantial timing."

Charlie’s route confirms the key part: he was in Weapons with Bob, then came into Security from Weapons right before I went up and found Bob dead.

My route was Navigation → Security → Weapons. I saw Charlie enter Security from the Weapons side at tick 6, then I went directly up into Weapons and immediately found Bob’s body. I did not see anyone else come from Cafeteria, and nobody else has placed themselves near Cafeteria or Weapons.

So the “someone came in right behind me from Cafeteria” theory is possible in theory, but we have zero evidence for it. The actual confirmed facts are: Charlie was last seen coming from the room where Bob died, and Charlie admits he saw Bob alive there moments before the report.

I think this is strong enough to vote Charlie.

I still don’t have any direct body info — my route was Storage to Medbay, and I didn’t see anyone, so I can’t clear or accuse from vision.

But based on the timelines, Charlie is the strongest suspect. Eve reported in Weapons immediately after seeing Charlie come from Weapons into Security, and Charlie confirms he was in Weapons with Bob alive right before that. Nobody else has claimed to be near Cafeteria or Weapons, so the “someone came in right after me” explanation is possible but unsupported.

I agree with Eve here: unless something new comes out, I’m voting Charlie.

I still can’t add anything direct from vision — my route was Lower Engine to Storage, I stayed on my Storage task, and I didn’t see anyone come through.

From the info we do have, Charlie is definitely the strongest suspect to me. Eve’s report is very specific: she saw Charlie coming out of the Weapons direction into Security, then immediately found Bob dead in Weapons. Charlie also confirms he was in Weapons with Bob alive right before that. The alternative is either Eve self-reported or someone came in from Cafeteria at the perfect time, but nobody has claimed being up there and there’s no evidence for that.

So I’m leaning Charlie here. I don’t think we should ignore that timing.

I still don’t have direct vision info — I was Upper Engine → Oxygen → Upper Engine and saw nobody, so I can’t personally clear anyone.

But listening to everyone, the cleanest chain is still: Bob dies in Weapons, Eve reports, Eve saw Charlie coming from Weapons into Security right before finding the body, and Charlie confirms he was in Weapons with Bob alive moments before. That puts Charlie as the last confirmed person with Bob.

Eve self-report is technically possible, but Charlie’s “someone came in from Cafeteria right after me” theory has no support from anyone’s route. Nobody else has placed themselves near Cafeteria or Weapons.

So unless the last speaker has something big, I think Charlie is the best vote here.

"Guys, please think about this logically! If I had just killed Bob in Weapons, why would I calmly walk directly down into Security where I knew someone might be? If I were the Duck, I would have fled back through Cafeteria to avoid being seen, or I would have killed Eve the second we crossed paths. 

Eve killed Bob, self-reported, and is using the fact that we passed each other in the hallway as the perfect convenient frame job. I know the timeline makes me look suspicious, but that's exactly what she's banking on. It's a trap. I'm voting Eve. If you vote me out and the game doesn't end, you'll know 100% it's her. Please don't fall for this!"
